from flask import Flask, request, g
import sqlite3
app = Flask(__name__)

DATABASE = 'guests.db'

def get_db():
    db = getattr(g, '_database', None)
    if db is None:
        db = g._database = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE)
    return db

@app.route('/my_guest_list')
def my_guest_list():
    guest_list = request.args.get('guest_list')
    query = f"INSERT INTO guest_list (guest) VALUES ('{guest_list}')"

    db = get_db()
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute(query)
    db.commit()
    return 'Saved guest list!'
